awesomeCursorSkills.name: suggesting-cursor-rules

awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Switch the active workspace to a different project using the `cursor-app-control` MCP, without opening a new window.

awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Automatically persist research, decisions, and learnings to workspace files so knowledge survives across conversations.

awesomeCursorSkills.name: verifying-in-browser
awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Start the dev server, open the app side-by-side with your code, and verify rendering, console, and network health.

awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Profile CPU performance of a running app using Cursor's browser profiler to capture call stacks and identify slow functions.

awesomeCursorSkills.name: parallel-exploring
awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Explore a large codebase fast by launching multiple read-only subagents that investigate different areas simultaneously.

awesomeCursorSkills.name: grinding-until-pass
awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Keep iterating autonomously — fix, run, check, repeat — until tests pass, the build succeeds, or linting is clean.

awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Scan running terminals for dev server URLs and ports, report what's running where, and open the app in Cursor's browser.

awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Watch a running process for crashes and stack traces, navigate to the failing file, and fix it automatically.

awesomeCursorSkills.summary: Monitor a build process for warnings and errors as they stream, fix issues before the build finishes.
